definitions.explanation: A rule or practice that people have agreed on, or that is taken for granted within a group, genre or tradition. Also an arrangement made between people.

examples.japanese: ⟦それ→それ：00994_sore⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{世界|せかい}→世界：01447_sekai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{約束事|やくそくごと}だ。
examples.english: That's one of the conventions of this world.
Our family has a few rules we've all agreed on.

examples.japanese: ⟦{歌舞伎|かぶき}→歌舞伎：04455_kabuki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{独特|どくとく}→独特：01656_dokutoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{約束事|やくそくごと}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}く→多い：01127_ooi⟧、⟦{知|し}っている→知る：00458_shiru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦{楽|たの}しめる→楽しむ：01203_tanoshimu⟧。
examples.english: Kabuki has many conventions of its own, and knowing them makes it more enjoyable.

notes:
SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{約束|やくそく}→約束：01517_yakusoku⟧: a promise or appointment with a particular person
- ⟦{決|き}まり→決まる：01233_kimaru⟧, ⟦ルール→ルール：00354_ruuru⟧: rules in general
{約束事|やくそくごと} stresses shared, often unwritten conventions that insiders take for granted.
